title: World Bloom — Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future — Episode9 Beyond the Tracks

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future
meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGER version of Leo/need's debut song is generating buzz, and Ichika and the others couldn't be happier. As the band renews their vow to make it as pros, a new area appears in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The tracks seem to extend towards that starry sky...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's incredible... I didn't realize a place like this existed in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We believe it's an entirely new area that appeared recently, rather than a place that's always existed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A new area...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes.
We understand that you and the others' feelings made it appear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Until just a minute ago, I'd been wondering what those feelings entailed...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you gave me the answer to that question, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why do you think this place appeared, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It may not be entirely obvious to you right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I believe you'll figure out the answer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You do...?
se_event_nightsky_2024_004

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? I'm hearing footsteps...
Hurry, you guys!
D-Don't run so fast! It's not safe!
See? She's getting way too excited again...

Huff... Huff...
Everyone, wait for me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are those kids?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But what are they doing here...?

Wow!
Look at the stars! They're so pretty!

They really are.
And it's rare for the sky to be so clear like this.
Oh, these tracks... They go up towards the sky... Does that mean this train can fly?

What?! That's so cool!
Then, wanna try boarding it?!
It might take us closer to those stars!

You're daydreaming again...
But I guess we could go on it for a little bit.

*Nod*
I'm a little scared, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Those kids...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They kind of remind me of us when we were little...)

Don't worry!
We're all boarding it at the same time!
We'll be able to go wherever we want as long as we stick together!

Hehe...
You saying that makes it feel true.
Yeah...!

I wanna go too.
Us. Together. Wherever we want...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Going wherever you want together...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those kids are just like you and the others, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I decided that I wanted to be with the others and become professional musicians together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But when we first started, we were the furthest thing from good...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And I was so nervous about performing in front of other people that I had a lot of trouble singing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I didn't run. I kept trying, practiced like there was no tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And we've been able to make it this far together as a result.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we can't stop here...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We have to keep moving forward. As far as we can. Even up among those stars.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to see what it's like up there with them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are these the feelings you were talking about, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I think you're in the right neighborhood...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
If that's the case...
Then I really want to go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The four of us. Together.
To the stars at the end of these tracks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll be able to, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wherever you want. As far as you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wonder what it's like beyond the stars at the end of these tracks.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I really have no idea right now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm going to keep doing my best so that we get to keep moving forward together.)
